question: Does the component STM32L476RGT6 have an output current of 20mA for any I/O pin according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: The datasheet for the STM32L476RGT6 (http://www.st.com/st-web-ui/static/active/en/resource/technical/document/datasheet/DM00108832.pdf) does not explicitly state that any I/O pin has an output current of 20mA. However, according to the datasheet, the total output current of the device is limited to 150mA for a temperature range of -40°C to 85°C and the maximum output current for any I/O pin is limited to 20mA for a temperature range of -40°C to 105°C, but this value can be lower depending on the specific conditions and configuration of the device.
